notes: Source footprint/contact geometry is retained. Repeated houses use shared estimated architectural templates, other ordinary buildings use shared mid-distance boxes and source-derived district proxies in the far distance. Heights/colours are source fields or deterministic estimates, not guaranteed surveys.

architecture.heightInference: OSM height/floors first; missing values use stable neighbourhood/footprint/type estimates. Source high-rise heights retained up to 650 m, never capped to a house template. Not surveyed heights.
